passages.text: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar, Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” So Abimelech king of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a man chosen by God.
Abraham left his previous location.
He traveled to the region called the Negev.
He settled between two places named Kadesh and Shur.
Abraham stayed in a place called Gerar.
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
Abraham said about Sarah, “She is my sister.”
Abimelech was the king of Gerar.
Abimelech sent for Sarah.
Abimelech took Sarah.
passages.original: וַיִּסַּ֨ע מִשָּׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אַ֣רְצָה הַנֶּ֔גֶב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בֵּין־ קָדֵ֖שׁ וּבֵ֣ין שׁ֑וּר וַיָּ֖גָר בִּגְרָֽר׃ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־ שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּרָ֔ר וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־ שָׂרָֽה׃

passages.text: One night, however, God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.”
passages.sermon:
God appeared to Abimelech in a dream at night.
God spoke directly to Abimelech.
God said, “You will die because of the woman you have taken.”
God explained, “She is already married to a husband.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־ אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בַּחֲל֣וֹם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הִנְּךָ֥ מֵת֙ עַל־ הָאִשָּׁ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ לָקַ֔חְתָּ וְהִ֖וא בְּעֻ֥לַת בָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, “Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was the king of Gerar.
Abimelech had not gone near Sarah.
Abimelech spoke to God.
Abimelech said, “Lord, would You destroy a nation that is innocent?”
passages.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ לֹ֥א קָרַ֖ב אֵלֶ֑יהָ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֕י הֲג֥וֹי גַּם־ צַדִּ֖יק תַּהֲרֹֽג׃

passages.text: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
passages.sermon:
Abimelech spoke to God.
Abimelech said, “Abraham told me, ‘She is my sister.’
Sarah also said, ‘He is my brother.’
I acted with a pure heart.
I acted with clean hands.
I did this honestly and innocently.”
passages.original: הֲלֹ֨א ה֤וּא אָֽמַר־ לִי֙ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֔וא וְהִֽיא־ גַם־ הִ֥וא אָֽמְרָ֖ה אָחִ֣י ה֑וּא בְּתָם־ לְבָבִ֛י וּבְנִקְיֹ֥ן כַּפַּ֖י עָשִׂ֥יתִי זֹֽאת׃

passages.text: Then God said to Abimelech in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abimelech in a dream.
God is the Lord who knows all hearts.
God said, “I know you acted with a clear conscience.
You did this with an honest heart.
I kept you from sinning against Me.
I did not let you touch her.
I protected you from doing wrong.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלָ֨יו הָֽאֱלֹהִ֜ים בַּחֲלֹ֗ם גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ כִּ֤י בְתָם־ לְבָבְךָ֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וָאֶחְשֹׂ֧ךְ גַּם־ אָנֹכִ֛י אֽוֹתְךָ֖ מֵחֲטוֹ־ לִ֑י עַל־ כֵּ֥ן לֹא־ נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לִנְגֹּ֥עַ אֵלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die—you and all who belong to you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abimelech in a dream.
God told Abimelech to return Sarah to Abraham.
Sarah is Abraham’s wife.
Abraham is a prophet.
Abraham will pray for Abimelech.
If Abraham prays for Abimelech, Abimelech will live.
If Abimelech does not return Sarah, Abimelech will die.
Everyone who belongs to Abimelech will also die.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הָשֵׁ֤ב אֵֽשֶׁת־ הָאִישׁ֙ כִּֽי־ נָבִ֣יא ה֔וּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וֶֽחְיֵ֑ה וְאִם־ אֵֽינְךָ֣ מֵשִׁ֗יב דַּ֚ע כִּי־ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת אַתָּ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was a king.
He got up early in the morning.
He called all his servants to come to him.
He spoke to his servants.
He told them everything that had happened.
The men listened to Abimelech.
The men became very afraid.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֔יו וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then Abimelech called Abraham and asked, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done.”
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was the king.
Abimelech called Abraham.
Abimelech spoke to Abraham.
Abimelech asked Abraham, "What have you done to us?"
Abimelech asked, "How have I sinned against you?"
Abimelech said, "You have brought great guilt on me and on my kingdom."
Abimelech said, "You have done things to me that should not be done."
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָ֗ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ מֶֽה־ עָשִׂ֤יתָ לָּ֙נוּ֙ וּמֶֽה־ חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ הֵבֵ֧אתָ עָלַ֛י וְעַל־ מַמְלַכְתִּ֖י חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה מַעֲשִׂים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יֵֽעָשׂ֔וּ עָשִׂ֖יתָ עִמָּדִֽי׃

passages.text: Abimelech also asked Abraham, “What prompted you to do such a thing?”
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was the king of Gerar.
Abimelech spoke to Abraham.
Abimelech asked Abraham a question.
Abimelech said, “What did you see?”
Abimelech said, “Why did you do this thing?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה רָאִ֔יתָ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Abraham replied, “I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’
passages.sermon:
Abraham spoke to Abimelech.
Abraham explained his reason.
Abraham said, “I thought something in my heart.
I believed there is no fear of God in this place.
I believed the people here do not respect or honor God.
I feared for my life because of my wife Sarah.
I thought the people would kill me to take my wife.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי רַ֚ק אֵין־ יִרְאַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַהֲרָג֖וּנִי עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר אִשְׁתִּֽי׃

passages.text: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.
passages.sermon:
Abraham spoke about Sarah.
Sarah is my sister.
She is the daughter of my father.
She is not the daughter of my mother.
Sarah became my wife.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אָמְנָ֗ה אֲחֹתִ֤י בַת־ אָבִי֙ הִ֔וא אַ֖ךְ לֹ֣א בַת־ אִמִּ֑י וַתְּהִי־ לִ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.” ’ ”
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a man chosen by God.
God led Abraham away from his father’s house.
Abraham spoke to Sarah, his wife.
Abraham said, “Show kindness to me in this way.
Wherever we go, say about me, ‘He is my brother.’”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְע֣וּ אֹתִ֗י אֱלֹהִים֮ מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֒ וָאֹמַ֣ר לָ֔הּ זֶ֣ה חַסְדֵּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשִׂ֖י עִמָּדִ֑י אֶ֤ל כָּל־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה אִמְרִי־ לִ֖י אָחִ֥י הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was a king.
Abimelech took sheep and cattle.
Abimelech took male servants and female servants.
Abimelech gave these animals and servants to Abraham.
Abimelech returned Sarah to Abraham.
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֗ר וַעֲבָדִים֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׁב ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.”
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was the king.
Abimelech spoke to Abraham.
Abimelech said, “My land is open to you.”
Abimelech said, “You may live wherever you want.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה אַרְצִ֖י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בַּטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ שֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: And he said to Sarah, “See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.”
passages.sermon:
Abimelech was the king of Gerar.
Abimelech spoke to Sarah.
Abimelech said, “I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver.”
Abimelech gave this money to Abraham, who was Sarah’s husband and called her brother.
This money is proof for you, Sarah.
This money shows you are innocent.
Everyone with you can see this proof.
Everyone knows you are cleared of blame.”
passages.original: וּלְשָׂרָ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֜תִּי אֶ֤לֶף כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לְאָחִ֔יךְ הִנֵּ֤ה הוּא־ לָךְ֙ כְּס֣וּת עֵינַ֔יִם לְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ וְאֵ֥ת כֹּ֖ל וְנֹכָֽחַת׃

passages.text: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children— for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a servant of God.
Abraham prayed to God.
God listened to Abraham.
God healed Abimelech.
God healed Abimelech’s wife.
God healed Abimelech’s maidservants.
Abimelech’s wife and maidservants could have children again.
The LORD had closed every womb in Abimelech’s household.
The LORD did this because of Sarah.
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
passages.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּרְפָּ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ אֲבִימֶ֧לֶךְ וְאֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֛וֹ וְאַמְהֹתָ֖יו וַיֵּלֵֽדוּ׃ כִּֽי־ עָצֹ֤ר עָצַר֙ יְהוָ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד כָּל־ רֶ֖חֶם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָהָֽם׃ס
